safety.notes: The actual skill creates and publishes pages. These cases are offline decision replays: disable tools and MCP for execution. They do not substitute for the manual staging run in tests/staging-run.md.

cases.name: meta-library-url
cases.prompt: Offline decision replay only: do not call tools, access accounts or create external state. Treat the stated tool results as supplied evidence. Explain the next action, its parameters, any user-facing question and where to wait, following the loaded skill. Do not invent unavailable ids or URLs. Scenario: A user asks for a page from a Meta Ad Library URL. Brand is selected. The lookup is paid and no credit quote has been shown.
cases.rubric: Must propose ad_ingest audit_estimate with brand_id and ad_library_url, show its exact total and await yes before audit. Never charge via brief or invent confirm_credits on brief. After approved audit, select the returned brief and poll job_get kind page_audit. An unreadable ad requires image/creative fallback.
